summary.text: Myles England is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 12 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. England has worked in data management.

paragraphs.text: England earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire.
England advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 12 on September 10, 2024, and again on September 8, 2026, when the four Democratic nominees defeated incumbent John Joseph Stone.
